_comment: Provenance for the vendored cedros:extension WIT. scripts/verify-wit.mjs fails the build when server-wasm/guest/wit/cedros-extension.wit no longer matches witSha256 (or, when CEDROS_DATA_DIR is set, has drifted from the host at sourceCommit). NEVER hand-edit the vendored WIT — re-vendor with `make vendor-wit`. A silent hand-edit here (crm-source-events.submit -> result<_> vs the host's result<string>) is what broke the 2.0.0 install.
